name: PATCH /api/admin/speech/catalog/:entry_id - Operator edits a catalog price or certification
description: Operator-only (x-admin-ops-token): edits one speech catalog entry at runtime, no deploy (322b0d69-8fde-47e0-aaf7-8c6420ed492b#AC2 — an operator can edit a catalog price or certification without a deploy). Editable: list_price, output_list_price (per_1m_tokens entries only, required there), price_verified (true stamps price_verified_at = now, false clears it), certification_status (certified | uncertified | revoked — certifying stamps certified_at, anything else clears it), cert_metrics, display_name, voices, languages, notes. Other fields (layer, provider, model, unit) are read-only. Returns {entry, changes} where changes maps each field that actually changed to {from, to}; a non-empty change set is audited as speech.catalog_entry.updated.v1. Certification is read live by presets and stack profiles, so revoking an entry immediately makes presets that use it unavailable (322b0d69-8fde-47e0-aaf7-8c6420ed492b#AC3).

testCases.name: Mark the entry price as not yet re-verified (idempotent)

errorCases.when: the body has a field outside the editable set, is empty, or a value is invalid (negative price, bad status, output_list_price on a non-token entry)
missing or invalid x-admin-ops-token (a tenant JWT is not accepted)
